##### Project general facts

Bonds Avenue by Amirah Development is a premium waterfront residential building that combines elegant architecture with refined, contemporary design. A longitudinal, connected layout ensures that every element of the building enjoys a view. The building rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, including penthouses, together with townhouses overlooking the pool.

Amenities support an active and relaxed lifestyle. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a kids' pool, a jacuzzi and a sauna, together with a state-of-the-art gymnasium and a yoga area. A padel court, a jogging track, mini golf and an outdoor cinema add variety, while landscaped gardens, a barbecue area and a children's play area create welcoming outdoor spaces for families. An elegant reception, corridors and elevator lobbies complete the shared areas.

Every apartment features smart home technology, en-suite bedrooms, guest toilets, spacious standing showers and balcony access from each section of the home, together with a private steam room. Two-bedroom homes add a study and a laundry room, three-bedroom homes add a storage room and a walk-in closet, and four-bedroom homes include a family lounge, a study and show and service kitchens. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens with Bosch appliances and granite countertops.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, made up of islands with beaches, marinas, resorts, parks and promenades. The area offers a relaxed island lifestyle with open sea views, beachfront hotels, retail and dining, together with landscaped green spaces and cycling and walking routes for residents and visitors throughout the year, just across the water from the historic heart of the city.

Deira, Dubai Creek and Gold Souk are a short drive away, and the Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with the city centre. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, while schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira, making daily life convenient for residents of all ages.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
